blocks.text: Stereoisomers ki mazeed do qismein hain:

Optical isomers woh stereoisomers hain jin ki physical aur chemical properties bilkul aik jaisi hoti hain, siwaye aik farq ke: plane polarised light ko ghumane (rotate karne) ki salahiyat. Aise isomers optically active kehlate hain, aur polarised light ke plane ko ghumane ki is khoobi ko optical activity kehte hain. Kisi compound ki optical activity plane polarised light (PPL) se pehchani jati hai. Agar compound light ke plane ko daen taraf (ghari ki sooiyon ki simt, clockwise) ghumaye to use dextrorotatory kehte hain aur (+) se dikhate hain; agar baen taraf (ghari ki ulti simt, anticlockwise) ghumaye to levorotatory kehte hain aur (−) se dikhate hain.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Polarimeter woh aala (instrument) hai jo PPL ki madad se compound ki optical activity pehchanta aur napta hai. PPL aik hi wavelength wali (monochromatic) light hai jo sirf aik plane mein chalti hai. Jis compound ko janchna ho us ka solution PPL ke samne rakha jata hai. Agar compound PPL ko ghuma de to woh optically active hai; warna optically inactive.

blocks.alt: Unpolarised roshni (har simt mein teeron wala daira) polarizer (patli khari jhiri wala daira) se guzar kar PPL (aik khare dohre teer wala daira) banti hai, phir Sample likhe dabbe se guzarti hai. Sample se do teer nikalte hain: aik daire ki taraf jahan dashed dohra teer khare rukh se ghari ki simt mein ghooma hai aur ghari ki simt ka mura teer hai (Dextrorotatory), aur doosra jahan yeh ghari ke ulat ghooma hai aur ulta mura teer hai (Levorotatory).
blocks.caption: Figure 19.4: PPL ki optical rotation (kitab ki Figure 19.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Khari seedhi teer wala plane PPL ka asal plane hai. Optically active sample se guzar kar yeh plane ghoom jata hai; dashed teer naya plane hai. Ghari ki sooiyon ki simt (daen) ghoome to compound dextrorotatory (+) hai; ulti simt (baen) ghoome to levorotatory (−). Mure teer ghoomne ki simt dikhate hain.
Optical activity aur compound ka structure

Compound ke optically active hone ki bunyadi shart yeh hai ke woh apne mirror image (aaine wali shakal) par poora na baithe (non-superimposable ho). Yeh shart asymmetric ya chiral molecules poori karte hain. Ise hamare daen aur baen haath ki misal se samjha ja sakta hai, jo aik doosre par poore nahi baithte (Figure 19.5). Lafz “chiral” Yunani lafz “cheir” se hai jis ka matlab haath hai; isi liye chirality ko handedness bhi kehte hain.
Jo molecules apne mirror image par poore baith jayein woh achiral hain aur optically inactive hote hain.

blocks.alt: Baayan haath (hatheli dekhne wale ki taraf, angootha daen), aaina, aur daayan haath (angootha baen) us ki aaina shakal; phir dono haath aik doosre par rakhe hue, 'nonsuperimposable' likha, angoothe ulti simton mein.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.5: Hamare haath apni aaina shakal par poore nahi baithte (kitab ki Figure 19.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baayan haath aaine mein daayan haath nazar aata hai, magar dono ko aik doosre par rakhein to angoothe ulti taraf rehte hain; yeh poore nahi baithte (non-superimposable). Isi ko chirality ya handedness kehte hain (Yunani “cheir” yani haath). Jis carbon par chaar mukhtalif groups hon woh molecule ko isi tarah chiral bana deta hai.

Jis carbon atom par chaar mukhtalif atoms ya groups lage hon use chiral carbon kehte hain. Jo organic molecule symmetric na ho aur plane polarised light ko ghumaye woh chiral ya asymmetric molecule hai. Agar molecule mein sirf aik chiral carbon ho to woh hamesha asymmetric aur is liye optically active hota hai. Lekin aik se zyada chiral carbons hon to molecule asymmetric aur optically active ho bhi sakta hai aur nahi bhi.

Aik chiral carbon wala molecule hamesha chiral aur optically active hota hai. Maslan lactic acid ka structure dekhein. Is ka aik chiral carbon (asterisk * se dikhaya gaya) chaar mukhtalif groups se jura hai: CH₃, H, OH aur COOH.

blocks.alt: Baen: CH3-C*H(OH)-COOH, carbon 3, 2, 1 numbered aur carbon 2 par sitara (oopar OH, neeche H). Beech: (-) lactic acid, sitare wala C, CH3 oopar, HOOC neeche baen, H daen taraf hashed bond par aur OH neeche daen thos wedge par. Aik dashed khari aaina lakeer. Daen: (+) lactic acid, is ki aaina shakal: CH3 oopar, COOH neeche daen, H baen taraf hashed aur HO neeche baen wedge par.
blocks.caption: Lactic acid aur us ke do enantiomers, (-) aur (+) lactic acid (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sitara (*) chiral carbon dikhata hai: is par CH₃, H, OH aur COOH, chaar mukhtalif groups hain. Moti wedge wala group dekhne wale ki taraf (aage) aur dashed wala peeche hai. (−) aur (+) lactic acid aik doosre ke mirror image hain, magar aik doosre par poore nahi baithte: yeh enantiomers hain. Dono barabar miqdar mein milein to racemic mixture (±) banta hai jo optically inactive hai.

Is ka teen dimension (3D) structure dikhata hai ke is ke do stereoisomers hain jo aik doosre ke aise mirror images hain jo aapas mein poore nahi baithte. Inhein enantiomers kehte hain (“enantio” ka matlab hai ulta, opposite). Enantiomers ki physical aur chemical properties aik jaisi hain, lekin yeh polarised light ke plane ko barabar miqdar mein ulti simton mein ghumate hain. Is liye aik enantiomer dextrorotatory (+) aur doosra levorotatory (−) hota hai. Jab 50% dextrorotatory aur 50% levorotatory enantiomers mile hon to un ka mixture optically inactive hota hai, kyun ke dono ki rotation aik doosre ko khatam kar deti hai. Aise mixture ko racemic mixture kehte hain aur compound ke naam se pehle (±) laga kar likhte hain. Is tarah lactic acid do optically active shakalon, (+) lactic acid aur (−) lactic acid, aur aik inactive racemic mixture (±) ki shakal mein milta hai.

Jin stereoisomers mein kam az kam do aik jaise chiral carbon atoms hon aur saath plane of symmetry (molecule ko do barabar hisson mein baantne wala plane) bhi ho, woh optically inactive hote hain. Yeh plane molecule ko do barabar hisson mein baant'ta hai, aur aik hissa doosre ka mirror image hota hai. Dono hisse polarised light ke plane ko ulti simton mein ghumate hain, is liye aik hisse ki rotation doosra hissa andar hi andar khatam (internally compensate) kar deta hai aur molecule optically inactive ho jata hai. Aise stereoisomers ko meso forms kehte hain. Tartaric acid is ki mashhoor misal hai.

blocks.alt: Peela dabba. Tartaric acid ki do Fischer projections, 'Mirror' likhi dashed khari lakeer ke dono taraf: baen COOH, H-C-OH, H-C-OH, COOH; daen COOH, HO-C-H, HO-C-H, COOH. Dono ke beech se guzarti dashed pari lakeer par 'Plane of symmetry' likha hai. Neeche: '1 and 2 are Identical and represent meso form of tartaric acid'.
blocks.caption: Tartaric acid ki meso shakal (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono projections aaine ki do taraf hain, phir bhi yeh aik hi molecule hain: daen wali ko kaghaz par 180 darje ghumayein to baen wali ban jati hai. Pari dashed lakeer plane of symmetry hai: oopar ka aadha hissa neeche ke aadhe ka mirror image hai. Aik aadha light ko daen aur doosra utna hi baen ghumata hai, is liye meso-tartaric acid optically inactive hai (internal compensation).

Kisi optically active compound ke zyada se zyada optical isomers ki tadaad 2ⁿ hoti hai, jahan n chiral carbon atoms ki tadaad hai. Lekin agar do ya zyada chiral carbons aik jaise hon to yeh tadaad kam ho jati hai (jaise tartaric acid, jis ki aik meso form hai).

blocks.prompt: Q1: Chiral ya achiral batayein: (a) pencil (b) kitab (c) joota (d) cup (e) kaan (f) paon (g) anda (h) chamcha.
blocks.explanation: Chiral: joota, kaan aur paon (har aik ki baen aur daen shakal alag hai). Achiral: pencil, kitab (saada shakal ke taur par), cup, anda aur chamcha (har aik mein plane of symmetry hai).

blocks.prompt: Q2: Glucose aur fructose do monosaccharides hain. i. Glucose aur fructose mein kitne chiral carbon atoms hain? ii. Dono ke kitne optical isomers mumkin hain? iii. Kya kisi ki meso form hai? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Open chain glucose mein 4 chiral carbons (C2 se C5) hain, is liye 2⁴ = 16 optical isomers; fructose mein 3 (C3 se C5), is liye 2³ = 8. Kisi ki meso form nahi, kyun ke dono ki chain ke sire mukhtalif hain (aik taraf CHO ya C=O, doosri taraf CH₂OH), is liye plane of symmetry nahi ban sakta.

items: Optical isomers PPL ko ghumate hain: (+) daen, (−) baen; baqi properties aik jaisi.
Chiral carbon par chaar mukhtalif groups; enantiomers aise mirror images jo aapas mein poore na baithein.
Racemic mixture (±) aur meso forms optically inactive; zyada se zyada optical isomers 2ⁿ.
